description: This file defines the LoggerData interface, which declares methods related to logger data and its conversion within the RomRaider project.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the logger data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger data.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the logger data.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected data convertor.

methods.name: getConvertors
methods.description: Returns an array of available data convertors.

methods.name: selectConvertor
methods.description: Selects a specific data convertor for logger data.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether the logger data is selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected status of the logger data.
